derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2556 (κακός);
def: not bad, i.e. (objectively) innocent or (subjectively) unsuspecting

occurrences.text: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
